title: Black/Green/yellow Vinyl Tubing | Whip Hose (900mm)
description:
This food grade vinyl tubing is perfect for any whip vape. And comes in various different eye catching colours that really brightens up you vaporizer.
Vinyl tubing does not pick up as much dust as silicone. It also tends to kink less then silicone hose.
